pages.text: Waterwheels and windmills turn shafts; shafts turn everything else. Hold $(l)W$() over any Create item to watch a $(o)Ponder$() scene showing how it works.

Put $(item)Mechanical Harvesters$() and $(item)Ploughs$() on a moving contraption and your fields tend themselves while you stay behind the walls.$(br2)Central Kitchen lets Create run Farmer's Delight cooking. Your toolboxes open on $(l)Right Alt$().
